items.title: Eindhoven-based Photon Bridge raises €10 million to build optical engines for AI and telecom
items.summary: Photon Bridge (formerly Photon IP), an Eindhoven-based startup building optical engines for AI and telecom, has raised €10 million to tackle an emerging bottleneck in AI infrastructure: producing the millions of lasers needed to connect increasingly large clusters of AI processors.
